thread:
claire: quick thought from today's design review — for the eval runs list, can we add a small inline helper per prompt-set row? idea: a short hover tooltip + keyboard-accessible "open details" action so screen reader and keyboard users get parity

oliver: yes to keyboard parity. tooltip should appear on :focus-visible and hover. keep it brief, link to the details panel for full context.

daria: copy needs tightening. current mock shows: "Why this prompt was picked, last score, regression delta, notes" — too long. suggest a one-line summary + a CTA to expand.

kevin: perf note: don't pre-render metric chips for every row. lazy-load the detailed content when the tooltip or details panel is opened.

claire: agreed. proposal: tooltip shows single-line summary e.g. "Last score 78 (−5). Open details (Ctrl+.)" — then Enter or Ctrl+. opens the right-side panel.

oliver: careful with shortcut choice. single letters conflict. prefer modifier (Ctrl/Meta) combos and make them configurable in settings.

daria: +1. also include mention of the shortcut in the tooltip for discoverability. for text: "Press Ctrl+O to open details" feels clear.

kevin: we already use Ctrl+O in other places. we'll compile an internal shortcut map to avoid collisions. devx can surface conflicts.

claire: accessibility checklist for this feature: 1) tooltip reachable via keyboard, 2) tooltip is announced via screen readers (aria-describedby), 3) actions announce success via aria-live="polite", 4) visible focus indicator, 5) reduced-motion respected.

oliver: UX nit: when tooltip opens via keyboard, Enter should move focus into the details panel and close the tooltip; Tab should move through interactive parts of the row, not trap.

daria: QA items: VoiceOver + NVDA checks, high-contrast check, keyboard-only navigation, and shortcut toggle in account settings.

kevin: implementation snippet idea: use `aria-describedby` on the row and `aria-live="polite"` for toasts. CSS: `.row:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid Highlight; }` and respect `prefers-reduced-motion`.

claire: microcopy question: approval verbs — do we keep "Approve/Reject" or use plain language like "Mark OK/Mark Problem"? want something clear for non-native speakers.

daria: prefer plain language. I'll draft a couple variants for product review to pick from.

oliver: visual: tooltip should have a pointer, 8px padding, and subtle shadow. for mobile, transform to a tap-to-expand mini panel — no hover there.

kevin: mobile-specific: add a visible info icon in the row that opens the same details panel; ensure it's reachable by keyboard and accessible via screen readers.

claire: rollout plan: behind feature flag, internal a11y pilot, then gradual rollout. owners?

oliver: I'll own mocks + shortcut map.

daria: I'll handle copy + QA checklist.

kevin: I'll own the spike for lazy-loading and ARIA implementation.

claire: thanks. I'll file a ticket and add the checklist and links to the mock. tagging @product-review for wording thoughts.

devx-bot: ticket created: PRJ-4830 — "Row helpers & keyboard flows for eval runs" (assignee: claire).
